name: waypage-share
description: Waypage's native pieces as a local Capacitor plugin (the same shape as LifeLog's native/widgets). No JavaScript: the app calls them as Capacitor.Plugins.ShareTarget, PageRender (Android), Print, FileSave, Files, Speech, Downloads and SignIn (Android and iOS), Brightness (Android and iOS), VolumeKeys, Feeds, Widgets, Translate and Drive (Android).
